cinder_mill.title: The Cinder Mill
cinder_mill.description: The mill has burned for seven nights without consuming itself. Soot falls like grey snow, and the millstone turns whenever nobody is looking.

ash_path.title: The Ash Path
ash_path.description: A cart track climbs through blackened fields toward the mill. Ash drifts over the ruts, and something four-legged keeps pace beyond the hedgerow.

ember_vault.title: The Ember Vault
ember_vault.description: Beneath the mill, a brick vault glows from a furnace that has no fuel. The air tastes of hot iron, and a figure of cinders waits beside the old altar.
